title: polypodium acrostichoides
intro: Polypodium acrostichoides, commonly known as the Rock Cap Fern, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium acrostichoides include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating various skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
